legal.privacy.title: Privacy notice
legal.privacy.intro: This QMS processes personal data to keep your bakery compliant with UK food-safety law. This notice explains what we collect, why, who sees it, and what rights you have under UK GDPR.
legal.privacy.controller_body: The deployer of this QMS instance — the food production business operating the bakery — is the data controller for all personal data processed here. Contact your line manager or the named compliance officer for the controller's full company details.
legal.privacy.what.users: User accounts: email, full name, language, hashed password, encrypted 2FA secret, login history.
legal.privacy.what.trainees: Trainees: phone number, full name, role, line, language preference.
legal.privacy.what.declarations: Training declarations: typed name, drawn signature, IP address, user agent, timestamp — kept as compliance evidence.
legal.privacy.what.audit: Audit log: a tamper-evident chain of every action taken in the system, including who did it.
legal.privacy.what.measurements: HACCP / SALSA / ticket records: process measurements, checklists, and corrective-action history.
legal.privacy.why.body: We rely on the following legal bases under UK GDPR Article 6:
legal.privacy.why.contract: Performance of contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — for user accounts of staff with QMS logins.
legal.privacy.why.legal: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) — for training records, declarations, and audit logs that UK food-safety regulation (EC 852/2004 Art. 4(2), Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013, FSA / SALSA / BRC inspection rules) requires us to keep.
legal.privacy.why.legitimate: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) — for security telemetry (IP address, user agent on declarations) used to detect impersonation.
legal.privacy.why.detail_link: Full per-dataset basis register: see docs/compliance/lawful-basis.md.
legal.privacy.recipients.body: Authorised staff (managers, QA, compliance, IT admins) inside the controller. External recipients are limited to: ClickSend (SMS delivery for training links), our SMTP relay (notification email), and inspectors from the FSA / local authority / retailer-audit bodies (e.g. SALSA, BRC) on lawful inspection.
legal.privacy.transfers.body: ClickSend processes SMS in Australia. We rely on the ICO-approved International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) or the UK Addendum to the EU SCCs to lawfully transfer the recipient phone number and message body. The audit log, user accounts, training records, and signature images stay on UK / EU infrastructure operated by the controller.
legal.privacy.retention.body: User and trainee records are retained while the person remains active plus the seven-year audit horizon required by FSA / retailer-audit lookback. Audit chain rows are retained for seven years; the personal-data fields inside an audit row may be redacted on a substantiated erasure request while preserving the chain integrity.
legal.privacy.rights.access: Access — get a copy of your data (UK GDPR Art. 15).
legal.privacy.rights.rectification: Rectification — fix data that is wrong (Art. 16).
legal.privacy.rights.erasure: Erasure — have your data removed where the law allows it (Art. 17 — note the audit-log carve-out under Art. 17(3)(b) for legal-obligation evidence).
legal.privacy.rights.restriction: Restriction — pause our use of your data (Art. 18).
legal.privacy.rights.portability: Portability — export your data in a machine-readable format (Art. 20).
legal.privacy.rights.object: Object — object to processing where we rely on legitimate interests (Art. 21).
legal.privacy.rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact your line manager or the named compliance officer. We respond within one calendar month.
legal.privacy.complaints.body: If you are not satisfied with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk or by phone on 0303 123 1113.
legal.privacy.cookies.body: We use only essential cookies: a session cookie to keep you logged in, a remember-me cookie if you enable it, a CSRF token cookie, and a small language-preference cookie. We do not run analytics, tracking, or advertising cookies and do not load any third-party scripts.
legal.privacy.security.body: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt; 2FA secrets are encrypted at rest with rotatable Fernet keys; magic-link tokens are HMAC-SHA256 signed and short-lived; the audit log is hash-chained and tamper-evident; sessions use Secure / HttpOnly / SameSite=Lax cookies; the application enforces a strict Content-Security-Policy and HSTS in production. Independent penetration-test scope is documented in docs/security/pen-test-brief.md.
